statement.zh: 教科文将梅萨维德国家公园列入世界遗产，强调崖居与台地聚落（UNESCO 27）。
statement.en: UNESCO lists Mesa Verde National Park as World Heritage, emphasizing cliff dwellings and mesa settlements (UNESCO 27).
